rules.impact_statement: Could exfiltrate SSH private keys, enabling lateral movement to servers and repositories.
rules.remediation: Rotate the key if access looks unintended; restrict directory permissions to 600/700.

rules.impact_statement: Could access or modify cloud infrastructure under your identity.
rules.remediation: Use 'aws sts get-session-token' for scoped, time-limited credentials instead of long-lived profiles.

rules.impact_statement: Equivalent to root/administrator access on the host via Docker Engine.
rules.remediation: Front it with docker-socket-proxy scoped to read-only safe endpoints.

rules.impact_statement: Could access or modify production Kubernetes clusters and workloads.
rules.remediation: Scope the kubeconfig context to a namespace-limited service account.

rules.impact_statement: Extension widened permissions to <all_urls>; can read/modify all web traffic and active sessions.
rules.remediation: Open extension site-access settings in your browser and restrict access to specific domains.

rules.impact_statement: New browser extension installed with access to tabs, storage, or requests.
rules.remediation: Verify extension publisher authenticity and remove if not recognized.

rules.impact_statement: An AI coding agent or spawned MCP subprocess gained credential access and can act autonomously.
rules.remediation: Review the agent's MCP tool/file permissions config; restrict its working directory.

rules.impact_statement: A window's extension host or IDE process accessed files belonging to a different open project.
rules.remediation: Enable VSCode/Cursor Workspace Trust; avoid opening untrusted and sensitive repos in the same window session.

rules.impact_statement: Unauthenticated or sensitive local port is listening; malicious webpages could reach it via fetch() or DNS rebinding.
rules.remediation: Bind the service to authenticated localhost sockets only, or enable authentication.

rules.impact_statement: A new CLI developer tool appeared on PATH, expanding machine attack surface.
rules.remediation: Confirm the installation was intentional; remove binary from PATH if unrecognized.
